title: Does anyone know what Battle UI script this image is using?

posts.author: Neil_Marie
posts.body:
This image comes from the
2014 OMORI Kickstarter
and was posted when the game was still being developed in VX Ace. It looks very earthbound inspired and I'd love to know if anyone knows if this was made directly for this version of the game or if it's a public script that can be found online.

posts.author: BCj
posts.body: Pretty sure this is probably done with Luna Engine VX Ace.

posts.author: Roninator2
posts.body: The updates about this says it is out for Nintendo Switch, so it's quite likely that is was not made with rpgmaker. or maybe made with MZ. Not sure if MZ can output to Nintendo Switch.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
@Roninator2
the OP said in the first sentence that the screenshot was from a time before they switched engines, when they were still using VXA.
@Dea_Pressed
I agree that it is most likely Luna Engine as all other engines have their own distinct look and Luna is the only one that could create looks far outside the default.
But that means a different problem for you: Luna engine is not a finished script, but a framework to enable you any form of view you might want.
As such it is somewhat easier to use than to program a comlete UI yourself, but it is NOT as easy to use as a finished script.
And I don't remember if any of the existing templates goes that way and can be used as a starting point, or if you have to devlop your own template to use.

posts.author: BCj
posts.body: It's definitley posisble to recreate the UI by starting off a template, but you do need to know some basic scripting, e.g. X/Y coordinates and so on.

posts.author: Roninator2
posts.body:
Andar said:
the OP said in the first sentence that the screenshot was from a time before they switched engines, when they were still using VXA.
Click to expand...
True, but since it was a kickstarter we can also agree that the scripts used for the old project are not available for the public. Only the Luna Engine Base scripts.
The OP can ask the developers what they used and if the OP buys Luna Engine he could maybe even ask for the old script files. Although very unlikely they will provide that or even still have a copy of them.

posts.author: KeatonGamer1248
posts.body: The OMORI GR2 Demo from 2014 seems to have been using a heavily modified version of Moghunter's Battle HUD. Some other scripts may have been used for the game's battle system such as Yanfly's Battle System Ace.
